screw_axial_screen.note: Conservative compression screen only; no thread, pin-hole, fatigue or bearing/catch rating acceptance.

blockers: Motor actual torque-speed/electrical/thermal data, weighed masses and radial bearing capacity under belt pretension
Vendor GT2 belt/pulley/idler/axle selection, positive drive-hub retention and matched metal clamp tooth form/pull-out proof
Spine/head/tube clearances, compression sleeves, fastener engagement, tensioner locking and bench anchors
Independent automatic fall protection still unselected; TR8x2/secondary nut/maintenance pin are not a safety system
Actual limits/door/E-stop/earthing/protection, flexible Z/servo wiring and control firmware
Screw/nut/journal fits, thrust preload, cross-pin/collar ratings and printed bin/latch endurance

belt_screen.note: Supplier belt width, cord, pulley minimum teeth, clamp tooth profile, bearing radial rating and tension must be confirmed; lower drive torque does not imply lower shaft radial load.

X_stand_screen.note: Isolated-leg ideal screen only; top/base bending, welded joints and actual belt direction excluded. Measure under selected tension.

tray_tube_screen.note: Assumes equal load sharing, ideal clamp and all head/payload mass at tip. No joint, guide or creep acceptance.
